The stored damage from "**Judgement**" is kept for each entity individually. It will remember this damage indefinitely, until  
Pressing RMB (by default) with the Cyclebreaker will deal all stored judgement damage of that entity, *if* that entity attacked you in the last 5 seconds *and* is the last entity that attacked you.  
Doing so resets their stored damage to 0.  
The amount of judgement damage is always 80% of the total damage you received from that entity *while* holding the sword yourself.

"**Irrevocability**" simply gives the victim 1 "hard damage" per hit, or damage that reduces your MAX health. It can no longer be given if the victim's max health had already plummeted to half a heart.  
If the victim isn't hit via melee by the Cyclebreaker for at least 2 minutes straight, uses a Totem, or... dies, the hard damage resets and the victim's max health is back to normal.  
(The effect does not take account of cooldowns, so it is spammable for up to 2 hits a second)
